decision.rationale: I recommend approving provisional credit of 399.34 EUR. TXN-008026 is a purchase of 399.34 EUR at BRAMBLE CLOTHING (MER-000024) on card CRD-000215. It posted on 2026-08-16 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 67 days, inside the 120-day time limit. The authorisation behind it, AUTH-008223, shows the payment was made online with the card not present (entry mode ECOMMERCE). The cardholder did not confirm it with the bank (3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED), no security code was given (CVV NOT_PRESENT), no PIN was entered, and the bank's fraud screening flagged it. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: the disputed purchase is the only one. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, a payment with the card not present, no 3-D Secure confirmation and the fraud flag set counts as unauthorised. The credit equals the transaction amount, which matches the cardholder's claim and is under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.
